minimum_contract: Caller authorizes exact source/staging instance identity and schema scope; opaque source identifier, observed time, PostgreSQL version/collation, exact source revision and export-format version. No credential or connection URL fields.

Use supplied read-only repeatable-read transaction; explicit completion flag and bounded row/UTF8 totals. Missing target, missing ledger, count/byte/recursive-dependency overflow must be incomplete/refused, not truncated success.

Fixed allowlisted pg_catalog relations/projections and exact schema-qualified relation OIDs; retain columns/types/null/default/generated/identity, PK/FK/CHECK/index definitions, RLS enable/force/policies, triggers and dependencies, relation ownership/ACL references with stated visibility.

Migration ledger is specifically permitted metadata: name/checksum/applied-step/finished/rolled-back state; never logs/errorSQL/connection fields or application rows. Preserve failed/incomplete and duplicate-name states, and completeness count; do not mark applied.

Catalog dependency closure must bound incoming/outgoing FK dependencies, trigger functions, policy functions/types/extensions/sequences as applicable. Record unresolved/omitted dependencies explicitly; api_keys-only is not full database/Workforce bootstrap proof.
Machine-sanitized report must distinguish exact content retained, digest-only content, redacted content and omitted content. Digest-only cannot serve as executable baseline.
hazards: Schema text can itself contain secrets/PII in DEFAULT/CHECK/policy expressions, function bodies, comments, names and owner/role labels. Schema-only is not automatically safe; do not emit raw pg_dump or unrestricted pg_get_functiondef/pg_get_expr output.

Never query pg_authid, pg_statistic, pg_stat_activity query strings, user rows or Prisma migration logs. Role membership/ACL identifiers need explicit source/package privacy handling; no role passwords or server connection provenance.

Do not introspect an arbitrary caller-provided table/query/schema string or execute generated DDL. Parameterize OIDs and values; no shell interpolation; actual DB access/export remains separately authorized.
Catalog MVCC snapshot does not prove deployed application revision, schema migration provenance, backups or cross-transaction consistency; instance/build identity must be attested separately.
Privileges/RLS may hide ledger/catalog data: empty result must not assert complete clean schema or no policies. Export source role authority and visibility boundaries explicitly.
Current-model SQL generation may prepare synthetic fixtures but cannot fill missing historicapi_keysDDL/ACLprovenance. No repair/mark-applied/production backup access in this scope.

eligible_roster_review.current_health_limit: Current health() scans only attemptstate, counts ineligible/inactive tracked rows and misses eligible orgs without state; TRACKED_ATTEMPTS_ONLY/NOT_MEASURED is accurate.
requirements: Enumerate active organizations independently, evaluate identical canonical workforce-hrm entitlement semantics, LEFTJOIN state so never-attempted orgs remain in denominator. No innerjoin, due-only filter or selection-page denominator.

One authorized snapshot and one observedAt instant for eligibility and attempt freshness; use clock/timestamptypes consistently. Canonical capability parser deliberately supports legacy shapes; do not silently redefine entitlement.

Count eligibleTotal, trackedEligible, neverAttempted, neverMatched, liveRunning, expiredRunning, due, latestFailure, staleLastMatched; document overlapping sets versus disjoint partitions. lastCompletedAt means lastMATCHED, not any finish.

Exclude inactive/disabled state from eligible coverage, optionally report separate fixed aggregate counts. Zeroeligible => NO_ELIGIBLE/NOT_APPLICABLE, not100%coverage. Never call missing/unobservable state healthy.

10001sentinel/rowcap/4MiB budget/invalid required row fields must produce finite UNAVAILABLE or explicitly incomplete observation; no partial healthy denominator. Counts are bounded integers, no raw metadata/IDs/tokens in returneddiagnostics or metriclabels.

Authorized cross-tenant visibility is a precondition; RLS-hidden organizations or hidden states can undercount/misclassify. Either verify the supplied visibility contract or label visible-only coverage, not globaleligiblecoverage.
Monitoring is read-only and dormant: no state insertion, due/lease/cursor mutation, new schedule, grants, notification dispatch or false claim of alert delivery.

Meaningful probes: missingstate; activeHRMdisabled; Route-only/Neither/Both; explicitHRMoff overridinglegacyMTM; staleMATCHED withlatestfailure; expiredRUNNING; exacttimeboundary; emptyroster; oversizedroster/metadata; hiddenRLS; concurrent entitlement/state changes in one snapshot.
